title: 使用AI代理自动化大规模黑盒审计个性化算法
summary: 提出一种使用生成式AI代理作为行为引擎进行黑盒审计个性化算法的框架。代理具有固定人格，基于人口统计和政治调查数据，与平台内容交互。通过在X平台部署1120个代理进行案例研究，发现算法推送放大有毒、极化、政治和右倾内容，且放大程度因用户意识形态而异。反事实分析表明人口统计信号以人格依赖方式影响内容传递。
summary_en: Proposes a framework using generative AI agents as behavioral engines for black-box auditing of personalization algorithms. Agents with fixed personas interact with platform content. A case study on X with 1,120 agents found algorithmic feeds amplify toxic, polarizing, political, and right-leaning content, with amplification varying by user ideology. Counterfactual analyses show demographic signals affect content delivery in persona-dependent ways.
